scope: Prospective independent OpenMULTI3D1D O41 solve on the exact5750/4.5/A8.70 source atom/atmosphere of the held MULTI reference. Native EOS/background/rate interpolation and boundary differences must be measured. No background line blanketing in this first continuum-only control; no solar fit, physical parity/admission or replacement of Bride/source/production. Second prospective control requests actual disk-centre output and disables per-depth early freezing (convmax0) so all saved depth rates belong to the same final global iteration. The first run was a departure-only calculation with no output spectrum. The native pressure-graded/interpolated depth grid must be registered explicitly before comparing source-node populations. Prospective dense output-only control: canonical AIR-to-vacuum conversion once before native synthesis; no change to the SE frequency grid or physical inputs. Prospective native EOS diagnostic: export explicit species; paired molecular-equilibrium native versus tmolim0 control. Changes are diagnostic physical interventions, not selected defaults or a fit. Compare atomic Oxygen totals, molecular reservoir, continuum and spectra; no molecular NLTE claim.
